And Lalo... boy, I never thought I’d get an Arabian. But after Brailey passed away and I met him at the shelter, something inside me said, “He belongs with us.” And yes… he absolutely does. Lalo is the sweetest boy, so loving and so innocent. He always shows up when he’s needed and has excelled in all of his training.
I think the key to success with horses is learning how to listen to them. Obviously, I’m not a professional trainer, but what I’ve discovered is that my boys always excel in the areas they love. The things they’re interested in, not necessarily what I’m interested in. Trying to force it is like fitting a square peg into a round hole, it just doesn’t work.
Find what your horse loves, and you’ll both succeed. ❤️
